choose.when:
select 'VLSTREAM' protocol, cast(v.id as char) row_id, v.device_id device_id, v.device_serial serial, v.device_name device_name, v.ip_addr ip_address, case when online=1 then 'ONLINE' when online=0 then 'OFFLINE' else 'UNKNOWN' end state, v.latitude latitude, v.longitude longitude, null device_type, null address from wvp_vlstream_device v
(v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} or (v.tenant_id is null and #{tenantId}=#{defaultTenantId}))
order by v.id
choose.otherwise: select null protocol, null row_id where 1=0
